notes.title: My Friend Peppa Pig - Pirate Adventures - DLC Release!
notes.notes:
Today, at Outright Games we have launched [b]the first-ever downloadable content for the acclaimed children’s video game [u][url=https://outrightgames.com/games/my-friend-peppa-pig/]My Friend Peppa Pig - Pirate Adventures[/url][/u][/b]. The DLC brings new characters, new locations and new ways to play as Peppa and the crew set sail once again. This new content is now available to purchase on [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1840890/My_Friend_Peppa_Pig_Pirate_Adventures/]Steam[/url][/u][/b].

It’s a pirate’s life for Peppa in this special adventure aboard Captain Hog’s boat hunting for hidden treasure. Explore all-new locations including Captain Hog’s Hideout, Belinda Bear’s House, Treasure Island, Mollie Mole’s house, and Danny Dog’s birthday party. As if that wasn’t enough , there are over thirty new activities to try out including raising a pirate flag and talking with Polly Parrot. Get ready to batten down the hatches and set sail with Peppa and her pirate pals!

[previewyoutube=0WI9DVTQO5Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]My Friend Peppa Pig, based on Hasbro’s #1 children’s tv show, was released in October 2021 on consoles, PC and Stadia, and then on next-generation consoles in January 2022, to huge acclaim from fans, parents and critics alike. The open-world, storytelling adventure game allows players to create their own avatar, become Peppa’s newest friend and explore fan favourite locations from the show.[/i]

[h1][b]KEY FEATURES[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]BECOME A PIRATE[/b] – Danny Dog’s party is the start of a treasure hunt across the sea!
[*] [b]PLAY IN NEW WAYS[/b] – Buzz like a bee, find a fossil, play with seashells, and try over 30 more interactions
[*] [b]FIVE NEW LOCATIONS[/b] – Including Captain Hog’s Hideout, Belinda Bear’s House, Treasure Island and more
[/list]
